screening.reason: Meets inclusion 2/3: analyses ABIDE I resting-state fMRI connectivity to classify ASD vs typical control with RNN/LSTM/CNN deep-learning models.

evidence_spans.text: we used the same 871 samples from the ABIDE 1 data set [23], [24], [25]. Of the 871 subjects, 403 patients were ASD and 468 were TC patients.
evidence_spans.claim: Cohort was a commonly-used 871-subject ABIDE I subset: 403 ASD, 468 TC.

evidence_spans.text: In this study, we used multiscale functional brain parcels. Brain parcels were created using a method known as the bootstrap analysis of stable clusters called BASC [32]. Scales were selected using a data- based method called MSTEPS [33]. There are different scales in this method. In this study, the scale is set to 122.
evidence_spans.claim: Parcellation used the BASC atlas at scale 122, selected via MSTEPS.

evidence_spans.text: An edge between a pair of ROIs is usually weighted with the Pearson correlation coefficient (PCC).
evidence_spans.claim: Functional connectivity edges were defined using the Pearson correlation coefficient.

evidence_spans.text: Tests on the ABIDE I data set were carried out using the 10-fold cross-validation method. The main purpose of this process is to use each data for both training and testing.
evidence_spans.claim: Evaluation used 10-fold cross-validation (no site-based split mentioned).

evidence_spans.claim: Best model (RNN) achieved 10-fold CV accuracy 74.74%, sensitivity 72.95%, specificity 76.28%.

evidence_spans.text: Table 2 shows the average classification performances obtained by 10-fold cross-validation tests. When the classification results are examined, it is seen that the highest performance value is provided by RNN with 74.74%.
evidence_spans.claim: RNN was the best-performing model at 74.74% accuracy.

narrative_row.study_design_sample_dataset: Diagnostic prediction; ABIDE I, a commonly-cited 871-subject subset (403 ASD, 468 TC), sites not itemised.
narrative_row.methods: BASC-atlas (scale 122) functional connectivity via Pearson correlation; RNN, BiRNN, LSTM, BiLSTM, CNN and CNN-hybrid classifiers evaluated with 10-fold cross-validation.
narrative_row.outcomes: Best model (RNN): accuracy 74.74%, sensitivity 72.95%, specificity 76.28%, comparable to or better than several prior published results on the same subset (Table 3 comparison).
narrative_row.key_limitations: No preprocessing pipeline named, no motion/QC rule, pooled 10-fold CV with no site handling, no leakage-control statement, and no code or participant-list availability.
narrative_row.relevance_notes: Uses the same widely-reused 871-subject ABIDE I subset as several prior studies, enabling direct accuracy comparison, but adds no new reproducibility information.
